items.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) Rolls Out New Media Panel For Biologics Development
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) has introduced the Gibco CHO-K1 Catalog Panel, a new off the shelf media offering for biologics developers. The panel includes cGMP ready, chemically defined, animal origin free basal and feed media aimed at broad process development and manufacturing use. The new solution is designed to give biologics and biosimilars producers scalable, ready to use options for cell culture performance, productivity, and product quality.
